adjudication_protocol.agreement_rule: Exactly two primary human submissions from distinct cryptographically verified unique-person subjects must independently agree on SAME_ENTITY or DIFFERENT_ENTITY.
adjudication_protocol.disagreement_rule: ABSTAIN_DISAGREEMENT; V0 does not majority-force or tie-break a disagreement into binary gold.
adjudication_protocol.insufficient_evidence_rule: Any primary human abstention, fewer than two verified independent origin roots, or fewer than two immutable evidence items yields an explicit abstention rather than binary gold.
adjudication_protocol.peer_blindness_proof: Every primary submission is an immutable service-signed receipt. The sealed-submission service assigns an authoritative sequence. Every required submission sequence must precede the signed peer-label-unseal receipt, and the unseal receipt may reference only already sealed submission receipt digests.
adjudication_protocol.unique_person_proof: Each submission binds an externally signed unique-person attestation. Validators cryptographically verify the attestation against an approved trust root and require two distinct subject digests; arbitrary person_key strings or self-reported booleans are forbidden as identity proof.

candidate_blinding.rendered_view_contract: The exact adjudication view is content-addressed. An offline validator recomputes every rendered-view digest and scans every rendered field against the exact internal candidate-signal boundary. A packet cannot declare itself candidate-disjoint.
candidate_blinding.redaction_receipt_contract: Each adjudication view is bound to its immutable raw evidence snapshot and candidate-signal boundary by a content-addressed redaction receipt. The validator independently rescans the rendered view; packet-supplied scan status is not authoritative.
candidate_blinding.direction_neutrality: Rendered evidence may contain factual evidence but MUST NOT contain decisive_direction, preassigned SAME_ENTITY/DIFFERENT_ENTITY conclusions, or other adjudication-outcome metadata. Per-item assessments exist only inside sealed authenticated human submission receipts after review.

closure.next_if_closed: Implement only the bounded offline packet expander/validator, blinding/redaction validator, signature/trust-root interfaces, and adjudication-receipt validator against synthetic vectors. Real label collection still requires separately frozen real trust roots and a durable real sample manifest.
required: all 24 synthetic protocol cases deterministically expand to their exact expected_packet_digest
candidate-disjointness is recomputed from exact content-addressed rendered views rather than self-asserted
origin independence is derived from cryptographically verified immutable provenance-root manifests and common roots collapse
rendered evidence contains no preassigned adjudication direction
distinct adjudicators are proven through cryptographically verified unique-person attestations and sealed submission ordering
EVALUATION_RANDOM sampling is bound to a content-addressed manifest durably published before first scoring
label bundles are versioned content-addressed manifests with predecessor identity and durability receipts
synthetic trust roots remain test-only and cannot authorize real labels
merge leaves entity quality INSUFFICIENT_INDEPENDENT_GROUND_TRUTH and grants no metrics/PASS/FAIL/promotion

evidence_protocol.candidate_dependency_rule: Immutable raw evidence provenance may not depend on the candidate-signal boundary or candidate output. Any candidate dependency digest invalidates the packet.
evidence_protocol.content_addressing: Raw snapshot metadata, rendered view, redaction receipt, origin-provenance nodes/manifest, sample manifest/receipts, identity attestations, sealed submissions, unseal receipt, and label-bundle manifest/receipt all have recomputable content identities.
evidence_protocol.origin_independence_rule: origin_group strings are forbidden. Each evidence item carries a signed immutable origin-provenance manifest from an approved capture-service trust root. Validators verify every node digest and parent link, traverse to root_node_digest, and collapse all evidence sharing the same verified root.
evidence_protocol.synthetic_mirror_attack: EGT-012 deterministically produces two publisher leaves with the same verified provenance root; it must collapse to one origin and abstain.

label_bundle_protocol.mutation_rule: Any payload mutation creates a different bundle digest. A signed durability receipt binds one exact bundle digest/version. Old and new bundle identities cannot be silently pooled or substituted.
label_bundle_protocol.later_evaluation_binding: A future separately authorized quality evaluation must bind exactly one immutable bundle digest.
label_bundle_protocol.synthetic_attack: EGT-022 mutates the bundle payload after its stored digest is frozen and must fail closed.

protocol_corpus.note: Synthetic hostile protocol vectors only. Their test keys/trust roots and expected outcomes are not real-world entity ground truth and cannot be counted as candidate quality evidence.

sample_protocol.challenge_rule: CHALLENGE_ONLY labels are diagnostic only and cannot enter headline quality metrics.
sample_protocol.evaluation_random_freeze: A content-addressed EVALUATION_RANDOM sample manifest freezes exact pair IDs, selection method, seed commitment, role, and creation time. A signed durability receipt must bind that exact manifest digest strictly before the first candidate scoring receipt for the same digest.
sample_protocol.synthetic_attack: EGT-020 keeps all identities internally consistent but places durable_at after first scored_at and must fail closed.

scientific_boundary.goal: Earn a future candidate-disjoint human gold-label substrate without circular reuse of candidate outputs or Frontier identity inputs.

trust_root_protocol.real_collection_gate: Before any real label collection, approved trust roots/keys for unique-person identity, sealed submissions/unseal, evidence-origin capture, redaction, and durability/publication must be separately frozen. Their identities may not be substituted after collection begins.
